annotations.text:
Colours here are the exact oklch values already in globals.css — nothing invented.

The one genuinely new proposal is the type pairing (Plus Jakarta Sans + Public Sans, replacing the Next.js default Arial stack). Both fall back to Helvetica/Arial, so nothing breaks if you'd rather not ship webfonts.

The structural argument. Today's six routes grew feature-by-feature; this is what the same data layer already supports.

Cost: two new routes, one merged, a role-aware sidebar. No schema, query or server-action changes.

Static mockups at desktop width (1440), not a clickable prototype — say the word if you'd rather have working controls to click through in the meeting.

People, teams and documents match prisma/seed.ts so the demo and the design tell the same story.
The new surface, and the one worth showing Jeane: it turns the red dots into a queue with a fix attached to each row.
